feedback: PASS. Plan decomposes the TDD into 4 atomic tasks (refactor hello.py, two unit tests, full-suite verify) with concrete, verifiable acceptance criteria, correct dependency graph (1 -> (2,3) -> 4), and 1:1 coverage of every TDD design element and PRD FR. Rigor is proportional to the trivial task surface; no manufactured ceremony. No blocking findings.

findings.message: TASK-002 acceptance criterion 'byte-identical except for surrounding whitespace' is slightly loose; the stronger 'git diff test_hello.py shows only additions' criterion in TASK-004 already covers it and is the binding check.
Parallel-track schedule is acknowledged as nominal (both Track A/B edit the same file); plan correctly notes the wall-clock saving is negligible and serializes in practice.
